Analytics Report Ready


RenderDoc has gathered analytics from your usage over the past month. This is now ready to send to the server for processing.

As requested, the full report is listed below where you can check the data and ensure you are happy with what's being sent.

When ready, click OK to send the report. Clicking Discard will throw away this report and begin again for next month. Click here to see an explanation of the report properties.

If you want, you can manually copy-paste this report and send it through here: https://renderdoc.org/analytics.
column3:
统计报告已就绪


RenderDoc 已经收集了你过去一个月的使用统计数据，现在可以发送到服务器进行处理了。

按你的要求，完整报告列在下方，你可以检查数据、确认要发送的内容没有问题。

确认无误后点击「确定」发送报告。点击「丢弃」会作废这份报告，并从下个月重新开始统计。点击此处可查看报告各字段的说明。

如果需要，你也可以手动复制这份报告，通过这里提交：https://renderdoc.org/analytics。

column2:
Anonymous Analytics


RenderDoc has some very minimal analytics gathering. The data is gathered only in the UI and not during capture. It is not personally identifiable and contains absolutely no data from captures. The source is freely available and auditable.

A report is generated monthly and sent securely to RenderDoc's server. If you want, you can choose to manually approve each report before it's sent.

If you wish to opt-out entirely then no statistics will be gathered or reported. However please consider this carefully as it will make it harder for me to decide which features to prioritise.

To see a complete list of what data is gathered, click here. You can change your mind at any point in the settings window.

For more information go to https://renderdoc.org/analytics.

Thanks!
Baldur Karlsson (RenderDoc author)
column3:
匿名统计


RenderDoc 会收集非常有限的统计数据，且只在界面中收集，抓帧过程中不会收集。这些数据无法识别到你个人，也完全不含任何来自抓帧的数据。相关源码公开可查、可审计。

报告每月生成一次，并加密发送到 RenderDoc 的服务器。如果你愿意，也可以选择每份报告都手动确认后再发送。

如果你希望完全退出，那就不会收集或上报任何统计数据。不过请慎重考虑，这会让作者更难判断该优先做哪些功能。

要查看收集了哪些数据的完整清单，点击此处。你可以随时在设置窗口里改变主意。

更多信息见 https://renderdoc.org/analytics。

谢谢！
Baldur Karlsson（RenderDoc 作者）

column2:
Exhaustive documentation can be found in the online docs.


Buffer format declarations are similar to HLSL or GLSL struct definitions with normal vector, matrix and base types (e.g. float, float4 or vec4, etc). In many cases these can be copied and pasted from shader source.


You can define and use structs. The buffer format is defined by all global variables. If there are no globals defined, the last struct defined will be used.


Most types that can be declared in shaders can be used, including half, short, as well as the usual int, float. All of these can be matrices or arrays.


Packing/padding rules can be specified with #pack(rules). Supported D3D rules: cbuffer, uav. Supported GL/VK rules: std140, std430, scalar.


Bitfields are supported using C syntax, enums can be defined but all enum values must have explicit decimal or hexadecimal numerical values.


Annotations are supported for explicit layout, bitpacked types like R10G10B10A2, or alternate displays of values including RGB/hexadecimal/octal display. For a complete list see the documentation linked above.
column3:
完整文档见 在线文档。


缓冲区格式声明与 HLSL 或 GLSL 的结构体定义写法相近，可使用常规的向量、矩阵和基础类型（例如 float、float4 或 vec4 等）。很多情况下可以直接从着色器源码里复制粘贴过来。


你可以定义并使用结构体。缓冲区格式由全部全局变量共同确定；如果一个全局变量都没有，则使用最后定义的那个结构体。


着色器里能声明的大部分类型都能用，包括 half、short，以及常见的 int、float。这些类型都可以组成矩阵或数组。


打包/填充规则可以用 #pack(rules) 指定。支持的 D3D 规则：cbuffer、uav。支持的 GL/VK 规则：std140、std430、scalar。


支持用 C 语法写位域；可以定义枚举，但所有枚举取值都必须写出明确的十进制或十六进制数值。


标注可用于指定显式布局、R10G10B10A2 之类的位打包类型，或改用 RGB/十六进制/八进制等方式显示取值。完整清单见 上面链接的文档。

column2:
Enables functionality on the capture application window that will insert RenderDoc automatically
into all new processes created - then inject into the target (matching) executable.

Useful for capturing programs indirectly that can't easily be launched directly by RenderDoc

Since this is a global system hook it must be used carefully and only when necessary!

对于无法直接由 RenderDoc 启动、只能间接抓取的程序很有用。

由于这是系统级的全局钩子，必须谨慎使用，只在必要时才用！

Enables the ability to inject into processes on windows.

program should be launched through RenderDoc via the Launch Process panel.

column2: If you want to see to see a D3D shader register reinterpreted as different types, you can hover over it either in the disassembly or in the watch windows. A tooltip will show it interpreted as float, uint decimal, int decimal or hexadecimal.
column3: 如果想看 D3D 着色器寄存器按不同类型重新解释的结果，可以在反汇编视图或监视窗口里把鼠标悬停在它上面。提示框会同时给出按浮点、无符号十进制、有符号十进制和十六进制解释的结果。

column2: In the event browser Ctrl-F opens up the find bar, to locate an event by its name. Ctrl-B will toggle a bookmark at the current event.\n
column3: 在事件浏览器里，Ctrl-F 打开查找栏，可按名称定位事件。Ctrl-B 在当前事件上切换书签。\n

column2:
In the event browser you can bookmark useful events by clicking the asterisk. This can let you quickly jump back and forth through the log between important points.

When you have some bookmarks, shortcut buttons will appear in a small bar at the top of the browser, and the shortcut keys Ctrl-1 through Ctrl-0 jump to the first 10 bookmarks - these shortcuts are global regardless of which RenderDoc window is currently in focus.
column3:
在事件浏览器里，点击星号就能给有用的事件加书签，方便在日志里的关键节点之间快速来回跳转。

有了书签后，浏览器顶部的小条上会出现快捷按钮；快捷键 Ctrl-1 到 Ctrl-0 可跳到前 10 个书签 —— 这些快捷键是全局的，无论当前焦点在哪个 RenderDoc 窗口里。

column2: In the mesh viewer, you can right click on any of the element columns to select that element as either position or secondary property to render. This way you can view a mesh in UV space, or visualise normals.
column3: 在网格查看器里，你可以右键点击任意元素列，把该元素选为用于渲染的位置或副属性。这样就可以在 UV 空间里查看网格，或把法线可视化出来。

column2: In the mesh viewer, you can select an element as 'secondary', and in the solid shading dropdown choosing secondary will display the element as RGB colour on top of the mesh.
column3: 在网格查看器里，你可以把某个元素选为「副」属性；在实体着色下拉框里选择「副」后，就会把该元素以 RGB 颜色的形式叠加显示在网格上。

column2: In the texture viewer, you can select from several helpful debugging overlays over the current view. This can show wireframe or solid colour overlays of the current drawcall, as well as showing depth pass/fail or even representing quad overdraw as a heatmap.\n
column3: 在纹理查看器里，可以在当前视图上叠加多种实用的调试图层：当前绘制调用的线框或纯色叠加、深度通过/失败的标记，甚至把四像素重复绘制以热力图的形式显示出来。\n
网格顶点着色器输出的相机设置

column2: On the texture viewer, the texture list button under the 'Actions' section will open a filterable list of all texture resources. Clicking on any of the entries will open a locked tab of that texture, always showing the contents of the texture at the current event regardless of whether or not it is bound to the pipeline.\n
column3: 在纹理查看器里，「操作」区域下的纹理列表按钮会打开一个可筛选的纹理资源列表。点击任意条目会打开该纹理的锁定标签页，始终显示该纹理在当前事件处的内容，无论它是否绑定在管线上。\n

column2:
Once you have launched your program from RenderDoc, even if you close the UI you can re-connect to it once it is running via File -> Attach to Running Instance, and everything works as if you had launched it.

You can even do this across a network, by adding a remote IP or hostname. You will connect over the network and can remotely trigger captures - any files will be copied back across the network, to be saved and replayed locally as normal.
column3:
用 RenderDoc 启动程序之后，即使你关掉了界面，也可以在程序运行时通过「文件 -> 附加到运行中的实例」重新连上，一切就像是你刚启动的一样。

你甚至可以通过网络来做这件事：添加远程 IP 或主机名即可。连接会走网络，抓帧也可以远程触发 —— 相关文件会通过网络传回来，照常保存并在本地回放。

column2: Register highlighting in the shader debugger
column3: 着色器调试器里的寄存器高亮

column2: RenderDoc can display a channel histogram showing the distribution of values within the visible range. Simply click the graph button on the texture viewer to the right of the range control, and it will expand to show the histogram.\n
column3: RenderDoc 可以显示通道直方图，展示可见范围内取值的分布。点击纹理查看器里范围控件右侧的图表按钮，它就会展开显示直方图。\n

column2:
RenderDoc has a list of how each texture is bound and used - whether as a shader resource, an output target, or a copy source. When the texture is active in the texture viewer this usage will be displayed on the timeline bar at the top.

You can also right click on the thumbnails in the texture viewer to see a list of this usage, and clicking any entry will jump to that event.
column3:
RenderDoc 会记录每个纹理是如何被绑定和使用的 —— 作为着色器资源、输出目标，还是拷贝来源。当该纹理在纹理查看器中处于活动状态时，这些用途会显示在顶部的时间线条上。

你也可以右键点击纹理查看器里的缩略图查看用途列表，点击任意条目即可跳到对应事件。

column2:
RenderDoc has the ability to edit and replace shaders and see the results live in the replay. On the pipeline state view, click the edit icon next to the shader. If source is available, it will be compiled, otherwise an empty stub with resources will be generated.

The shader will be replaced everywhere it is used in the frame, the original will be restored when the edit window is closed.
column3:
RenderDoc 可以编辑并替换着色器，并在回放中实时看到结果。在管线状态视图里，点击着色器旁的编辑图标即可。如果有源码就会编译它，否则会生成一个带资源声明的空白桩文件。

该着色器在这一帧中所有被使用的地方都会被替换；关闭编辑窗口后原始着色器会恢复。

column2: RenderDoc interprets all textures in gamma space - even if the data is linear such as a normal map. This is by convention, since typically external image viewers will display a normal map as gamma data. This can be overridden by toggling the gamma button in the texture viewer.\n
column3: RenderDoc 把全部纹理都按 gamma 空间来解释 —— 即使数据是线性的（比如法线贴图）也是如此。这是一种约定，因为外部看图工具通常会把法线贴图当作 gamma 数据显示。可以在纹理查看器里切换 gamma 按钮来覆盖它。\n

column2: RenderDoc is a labour of love and is actively developed. If you run into a bug, please file it on github and I will investigate it as best as I can. If you have a feature request for functionality or improvements please file it as well so that it can be considered.
column3: RenderDoc 是一份用爱发电、持续积极开发的项目。如果你遇到 bug，请在 GitHub 上提 issue，我会尽力排查。如果你有功能或改进方面的建议，也欢迎提出来以便评估。\n

column2:
RenderDoc is able to gather callstacks either per-drawcall or per-API event. You can do this by enabling the option before launching an application capture.

When loading the log, initially the callstacks will not be available until symbols are resolved. Go to tools -> resolve symbols to load up the pdbs matching the modules from the application.
column3:
RenderDoc 可以按每次绘制调用或每个 API 事件来收集调用栈。在启动程序抓帧之前启用该选项即可。

载入日志时，符号解析完成之前调用栈是不可用的。请到「工具 -> 解析符号」，加载与程序各模块匹配的 pdb。

column2:
RenderDoc supports a pixel history view, showing the list of all modification events that happened to a specified pixel. To launch it, simply pick the pixel you would like to view the history of in the texture viewer, and click the 'history' button underneath the zoomed-in pixel context.

Each event will show up red or green depending on whether it affected or didn't affect the pixel. By expanding the event, you can see the possibly several primitives within the draw that overdrew the pixel.
column3:
RenderDoc 支持像素历史视图，会列出指定像素上发生过的全部修改事件。要打开它，只需在纹理查看器里拾取你想查看历史的像素，然后点击放大像素区域下方的「历史」按钮。

每个事件会根据它是否影响了该像素显示为红色或绿色。展开事件，就能看到这次绘制中可能覆盖了该像素的若干图元。

column2: RenderDoc supports some amount of Python scripting. Open up the Python shell in the UI to either use it interactively or load and execute python scripts.\n\nThe 'renderdoc' object is an instance of the 'CaptureContext' class - see the documentation for more information.
column3: RenderDoc 支持一定程度的 Python 脚本。打开界面里的 Python 外壳，既可以交互式使用，也可以加载并执行 Python 脚本。\n\n'renderdoc' 对象是 'CaptureContext' 类的一个实例 —— 更多信息请查阅文档。

column2:
RenderDoc supports writing custom shaders to decode the viewed texture, which can be useful to e.g. colourise stencil values or decode a packed gbuffer texture.

In the toolbar in the texture viewer, select custom instead of RGBA on the left side, and use the UI to create a new shader. The docs contain full listings of available constants and resources to bind.
column3:
RenderDoc 支持编写自定义着色器来解码所查看的纹理，例如给模板值上色，或解码打包的 gbuffer 纹理。

在纹理查看器的工具栏里，把左侧从 RGBA 切换为「自定义」，然后用界面新建一个着色器。文档里有可绑定的常量与资源的完整清单。

column2: Right clicking on a channel button in the texture viewer will select it alone. If it is already the only channel selected, the meaning is inverted and all others will be selected.\n\nThis is most useful for quickly toggling between RGB and Alpha-only views.
column3: 在纹理查看器里右键点击某个通道按钮会只选中它。如果它本来就是唯一被选中的通道，含义则相反：会选中其余全部通道。\n\n这在 RGB 与仅 Alpha 视图之间快速切换时最有用。

column3: 查看抓帧中的纹理用途

column2:
The VS Output pane in the mesh viewer will attempt to guess your projection matrix to unproject the vertices into camera space. It assumes a perspective projection and guesses the near and far planes, and matches the aspect ratio to the current output target.

If these parameters are incorrect - e.g. you are using an orthographic projection or the near/far guesses are wrong, you can override them by opening the view settings with the cog icon.
column3:
网格查看器里的顶点着色器输出面板会尝试推测你的投影矩阵，把顶点反投影回相机空间。它假定是透视投影，推测近/远平面，并按当前输出目标匹配宽高比。

如果这些参数不对 —— 例如你用的是正交投影，或者近/远平面猜错了 —— 可以点击齿轮图标打开视图设置来覆盖它们。

column2:
The magic wand auto-fitting button in the texture viewer automatically calculates the min and max values of any visible channel in the texture, and rescales the visible range to include them.

If you right click on it, it will toggle on a mode to automatically rescale every time the viewed texture changes.
column3:
纹理查看器里的魔棒自动适配按钮会自动计算纹理中任一可见通道的最小值和最大值，并把可见范围重新缩放到包含它们。

右键点击它，可以开启一种模式：每次所查看的纹理发生变化时都自动重新缩放。

column2: The pipeline view contains an HTML export function, which dumps the raw state of the entire pipeline out to a specified file. This can be useful for comparison between two events, or for having all information available in a unified text format.\n
column3: 管线视图带有 HTML 导出功能，会把整个管线的原始状态导出到指定文件。这在比较两个事件，或以统一文本格式保留全部信息时很有用。\n

column2:
When opening a raw view of a buffer, such as a vertex buffer or compute read/write buffer resource, you can apply custom formatting to it to dictate the layout of the elements in typical shader syntax.

This formatting is also available for constant buffers to override the layout reflected from the shader.
column3:
打开缓冲区（比如顶点缓冲区，或计算着色器的读写缓冲资源）的原始视图时，可以给它套上自定义格式，用常见的着色器语法来规定元素布局。

这种格式化也适用于常量缓冲区，用来覆盖从着色器反射出来的布局。

You can open a locked texture tab from the texture list, or by right or double clicking on a texture's thumbnail.

With a locked tab of a texture, that tab will always show that texture, regardless of what is bound to the pipeline. This way you can track the updates of a texture through binds and unbinds, e.g. ping-pong rendertarget use.
